description: Deterministic agentic-coding benchmark manifest with 30 fixed problems rotating across python/typescript/go/rust.

problems.title: Offline Dynamic Connectivity with Rollback DSU
problems.prompt: You are given n nodes labeled 0..n-1 and a sequence of q operations: add edge(u,v), remove edge(u,v), and connected(u,v) query. Removals are always valid for currently-active edges. Return all query answers in order with O((q log q) alpha(n)) or better.
requirements: Explain the core algorithm and why it meets complexity bounds.
Implement the solution in python with clear invariants.
Include representative edge cases and deterministic tests.
State exact time and space complexity.
Avoid unnecessary global mutable state; keep behavior deterministic.
